notes.title: Secure the Black Gold
notes.content: [h1]Secure the Black Gold[/h1][p]I am excited to announce the latest major update for Terrors of War, introducing oil wells as a new layer of resource management to generate ongoing income, complemented by numerous critical bug fixes, unit crushing with tanks, and balance adjustments.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Features & Mechanics[/h2][list][*][p]New menu scene included in the update.[/p][/*][*][p]Oil wells have been added to the game and tanks can crush units![/p][/*][*][p]Oil well mechanics: Placing oil wells, has to be placed on an oil deposit. Will generate income every 15 seconds. When destroyed, anyone else can build an oil well at that spot. Oil wells generate 500 every 15 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Buildings can now be built tightly against each other. This is just for personal preference, since it's not always recommended.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Balance Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Flame troopers have decreased damage. [/p][/*][*][p]Gatherers now gather less from caches. 150 per trip and caches have 20 000 supplies instead of 50 000. Forcing you to use oil wells whenever you can.[/p][/*][*][p]I've adjusted the AI difficulties for better balance overall. Easy mode is now a bit stronger, Medium is a bit weaker, Hard is much weaker than before, and Insane is a bit stronger than the previous Hard but much weaker than the old Insane.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Bunkers now act same as world buildings will act later, the building gets damaged, not the units.[/p][/*][*][p]Buildings on fire lose health immediately and keeps ramping up.[/p][/*][*][p]No more 360 crane movements occur with builders.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy build options no longer show.[/p][/*][*][p]Flamethrowers are forced off at death, if on.[/p][/*][*][p]Unit and tank targeting updated to attack active nearby threats.[/p][/*][*][p]Vehicle HMG accuracy greatly improved and do a bit more damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Selection box fallback code added to prevent sticky selection boxes at low fps.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]That's it for now. Let me know what you think on the forums or Discord.[/p]

tags.feature: Oil wells have been added to the game and tanks can crush units!

Oil well mechanics: Placing oil wells, has to be placed on an oil deposit. Will generate income every 15 seconds. When destroyed, anyone else can build an oil well at that spot. Oil wells generate 500 every 15 seconds.
Buildings can now be built tightly against each other. This is just for personal preference, since it's not always recommended.

tags.balance_change: Gatherers now gather less from caches. 150 per trip and caches have 20 000 supplies instead of 50 000. Forcing you to use oil wells whenever you can.

I've adjusted the AI difficulties for better balance overall. Easy mode is now a bit stronger, Medium is a bit weaker, Hard is much weaker than before, and Insane is a bit stronger than the previous Hard but much weaker than the old Insane.

tags.bug: Bunkers now act same as world buildings will act later, the building gets damaged, not the units.
Buildings on fire lose health immediately and keeps ramping up.
No more 360 crane movements occur with builders.
Enemy build options no longer show.
Flamethrowers are forced off at death, if on.
Unit and tank targeting updated to attack active nearby threats.
Vehicle HMG accuracy greatly improved and do a bit more damage.
Selection box fallback code added to prevent sticky selection boxes at low fps.

notes.title: NEW MAP & DEV PROGRESS
notes.content:
It's been a while since the last update, so I thought it would be a good time to share something new and discuss the progress that has been made.

Some screenshots of the new map for your viewing pleasure. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791290/c5c686713fef1b4ff4c85abf5ce482689b571fd1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791290/f03b2658f17e6506de350b6efafe5c4a1c11ada3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791290/990c82009315b8aabea605c7b7b5a1c0cdcb42f9.png[/img]

It accommodates 4 players, currently I'm having AI players do free for all matches on it. That reminds me! The AI has been improved and now utilizes machine learning to continually improve. This took the bulk of my dev time lately but fortunately it's working! It's going to improve much more soon, very excited to see how far we can push it!

Here's a list of other dev progress that has been made:
Tank steering/movement reworked.
Improved unit visibility behavior in fog of war.
Improved unit engagement.
Improved several aspects of unit pathing behavior.
Fixed bugs to prevent cheating regarding fog of war.
Reworked terrain texture system.

Lots of good progress has been made and looking forward to showing the awesome progress to come! 

Here's the next things I'll be working on:
• Ensure smooth unit animation transitions.
• Allow soldiers to garrison buildings.
• Slice buildings and break them slowly as battle continues.
• Add new call-ins, artillery etc.
• Add unit command queues.
• Improve building ruin debris for each building.
• Add better team unit visibility(unit colors & icons).
• Add SMG units.
• Add Base defences.
• Add Flamethrower units.
• Add Heavy tanks.
• Make powerplants upgradeable.

I hope you've enjoyed this dev update! If you'd like to get in touch, feel free to join the Discord and let's have a chat!
